source_disclaimer: Source descriptions are research leads, not independently licensed or approved products.

entries.name: Agent Skills format
entries.purpose: Reusable, on-demand SKILL.md and referenced guidance, with explicit tool boundary
entries.research_caution: Skill is untrusted instructions plus optional scripts; never auto-activate external skills

entries.name: Hugging Face Skills
entries.purpose: Discovery grammar for model/dataset tooling skills
entries.research_caution: Do not run CLI, cloud, or model downloads without source and authority review

entries.name: MCP specification
entries.purpose: Read-only capability declaration and external-tool boundary design
entries.research_caution: Server tool descriptions cannot grant repository, network, member or shell authority

entries.name: Hugging Face smolagents
entries.purpose: Composable tool-using agents and model-agnostic adapters
entries.research_caution: Local Python executor is not sandbox: agent-generated code requires independently governed isolation

entries.name: DSPy
entries.purpose: Declarative reusable LM modules and optimization concepts
entries.research_caution: Optimization must not update frozen benchmark or MAIA prompts without new approval

entries.name: LangGraph
entries.purpose: Compare durable execution, checkpointing and human review with JARVIS W0/v2
entries.research_caution: Do not replace JARVIS constitutional governor; imported runtime grants nothing

entries.name: Hugging Face Transformers
entries.purpose: Model architecture and local inference adapters for experimental evaluation
entries.research_caution: Model code, weights and licenses require exact revision review

entries.name: Apple MLX-LM
entries.purpose: Apple-silicon-efficient inference/probing candidate on Mac Studio
entries.research_caution: Benchmark memory pressure offline; no automatic download or MAIA model swap

entries.name: Hugging Face PEFT
entries.purpose: LoRA-style parameter-efficient adaptation for separately authorized experimental studies
entries.research_caution: Weights training or modification is a new experimental gate; not to infer development from behavior

entries.name: Hugging Face Datasets
entries.purpose: Versioned synthetic/public datasets and streaming ingestion patterns
entries.research_caution: Dataset licenses, deidentification, consent, PHI and leakage audit required before use

entries.name: Hugging Face Hub model discovery
entries.purpose: Discovery of candidate model cards and licenses without weights ingestion
entries.research_caution: Open weights do not imply open license, safe code, or Mac compatibility

entries.name: Safetensors
entries.purpose: Safe weight serialization and revision-pinned artifact verification
entries.research_caution: Prefer safetensors over pickle; never trust remote code by default

entries.name: Hugging Face pickle scanning guidance
entries.purpose: Source artifact security threat library
entries.research_caution: Repository scan does not independently establish a safe model

entries.name: PyPI LiteLLM supply chain incident
entries.purpose: Supply-chain failure cases for dependency admission
entries.research_caution: Pinned clean hashes, external advisories, SBOM and isolated build mandatory

entries.name: Inspect AI
entries.purpose: Evaluation suite framework, repeatable traces and human-readable results
entries.research_caution: No clinical/member-data testing without separate authorization

entries.name: LM Evaluation Harness
entries.purpose: Fixed benchmark/adapter evaluations with plugins
entries.research_caution: Never redefine frozen RGR-04/RGR-06 metrics or rescue RGR-05 infeasibility

entries.name: Promptfoo
entries.purpose: RAG retrieval/generation evaluation and prompt red-team scenarios
entries.research_caution: Run with synthetic corpus and strictly local providers only

entries.name: TransformerLens
entries.purpose: Inspect neural activations and controlled activation patching
entries.research_caution: Interpretability findings not equivalent to human meaning, consciousness or relationship

entries.name: SAELens
entries.purpose: Sparse autoencoders and feature interpretability on open-weight models
entries.research_caution: Feature naming provisional; no ontology promotion from SAE features

entries.name: pyvene
entries.purpose: Counterfactual internal-state interventions for relational sensitivity tests
entries.research_caution: Only open weights, synthetic datasets, separately authorized research

entries.name: NNsight
entries.purpose: Trace and intervene on model forward passes
entries.research_caution: Remote tracing prohibited without data/privacy approval; start offline only

entries.name: DoWhy
entries.purpose: Causal assumptions, counterfactual reasoning and falsification tools
entries.research_caution: Causal claims need identification assumptions; no clinical causal diagnosis

entries.name: Microsoft GraphRAG
entries.purpose: Graph-shaped retrieval and provenance design patterns
entries.research_caution: Repository in maintenance mode; design reference rather than production dependency; cost/privacy review

entries.name: Zur et al. counterfactual trace paper
entries.purpose: Research reference for competing trajectories and internal uncertainty
entries.research_caution: Bounded model/task claims; must not infer MAIA introspection or sentience

entries.name: Zhou et al. trajectory geometry paper
entries.purpose: Research reference for representation trajectories, curvature and geometry
entries.research_caution: External scholarly claim; not a validated RGR formalism

entries.name: Sophontic paired perturbation evals
entries.purpose: Minimal relation-breaking vs surface-preserving contrast fixtures
entries.research_caution: Source design inspiration only; preregister own controls before tests
